headline: Entered closed session to discuss strategy for ongoing litigation; the meeting did not reconvene in open session.
summary: Members voted 7-0 by roll call to enter executive session under Mass. G.L. c. 30A, Section 21(a)(3), to discuss strategy for ongoing litigation. The minutes state that the meeting would not reconvene in open session, and the group moved to the mayor's chambers at 6:02 PM.

MINUTES OF THE SCHOOL COMMITTEE  
SPECIAL MEETING 
Wednesday, August 19, 2026 
 
LOCATION 
Springfield Public Schools, 1550 Main Street 2 FLR, New England Boardroom, Springfield, MA 
 
I. CALL TO ORDER – SPECIAL MEETING – ROLL CALL 
Chairman, Mayor Sarno called the Special Meeting to order at 6:00 PM. 
Roll Call Attendance: 
Ms. Valentin - Present 
Ms. Crawford - Present 
Ms. Hurst - Present 
Mr. Gomez, Jr. - Present 
Ms. Gresham – Present 
Ms. Monroe Naylor (Vice Chair) - Present 
Mayor Sarno (Chair) - Present 
 
A. Invocation 
A moment of silence was held. 
B. Pledge of Allegiance 
The pledge of allegiance was led by Mayor Sarno. 
II. Vote to enter into Executive Session in accordance with Mass. G.L. c. 30A, Section 21(a)(3), 
to discuss strategy for ongoing litigation, as an open meeting would have a detrimental 
effect on the body's litigating position.  
 
On a motion made by Ms. Monroe Naylor and seconded by Ms. Valentin, a roll-call vote was 
taken. It was noted that the School Committee will not reconvene into open session concluding 
the Executive Session. 
 
Roll Call Vote:  
Ms. Valentin - Yes 
Ms. Crawford - Yes 
Ms. Hurst - Yes 
Mr. Gomez, Jr. - Yes 
Ms. Gresham - Yes
